title: Fix ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, and ContactSection raw translation key rendering

requirements.summary: Fix all nine translation keys in ExportCargoSection so they resolve to human-readable text instead of raw key strings, ensuring exact camelCase matching between component usage and translations.ts definitions
acceptanceCriteria: ExportCargoSection renders 'Export & Cargo' (or translated equivalent) as the section label — never the raw string 'EXPORTCARGO.SECTIONLABEL'
exportCargo.heading renders as 'Global Exports' in English, with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
exportCargo.subheading renders as a readable sentence in all three language modes
All three highlight title/desc pairs (highlight1, highlight2, highlight3) render as readable English, Hindi, and Marathi text
No raw key string, escaped character, or JSON fragment is visible in the ExportCargoSection at any viewport size in any language mode
The translation keys in ExportCargoSection.tsx exactly match the keys defined in translations.ts (correct camelCase, no uppercase mismatch)

file_operations.description: Update all t() translation helper calls to use exact camelCase key names: 'exportCargo.sectionLabel' (not 'EXPORTCARGO.SECTIONLABEL'), 'exportCargo.heading', 'exportCargo.subheading', 'exportCargo.highlight1Title', 'exportCargo.highlight1Desc', 'exportCargo.highlight2Title', 'exportCargo.highlight2Desc', 'exportCargo.highlight3Title', and 'exportCargo.highlight3Desc'. Verify each key matches the translations.ts structure exactly (camelCase dot-notation). Ensure the component correctly receives and uses the t() function from LanguageContext.

Add or update all nine exportCargo translation keys for all three language codes (en, hi, mr) with non-empty human-readable strings. English values: 'exportCargo.sectionLabel' = 'Export & Cargo', 'exportCargo.heading' = 'Global Exports', 'exportCargo.subheading' = a concise supporting sentence about TrueOrigin Exports' professional export and shipping capabilities, 'exportCargo.highlight1Title' = 'Export Documentation', 'exportCargo.highlight1Desc' = a concise description of export documentation readiness, 'exportCargo.highlight2Title' = 'Secure Packaging', 'exportCargo.highlight2Desc' = a concise description of packaging standards, 'exportCargo.highlight3Title' = 'Global Reach', 'exportCargo.highlight3Desc' = a concise description of international shipping capability. Provide appropriate Hindi and Marathi translations for all nine keys. Ensure no raw key strings, JSON objects, or template literal artifacts remain.

requirements.summary: Fix all five translation keys in ContactSection so they resolve to human-readable text instead of raw key strings, ensuring exact nested dot-path matching
acceptanceCriteria: ContactSection renders 'Get In Touch' (or translated equivalent) as the section heading — never the raw string 'contact.heading'
contact.subheading renders as a readable sentence in all three language modes
contact.info.heading renders as 'Contact Information' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
contact.form.heading renders as 'Send an Enquiry' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
contact.form.submit renders as 'Submit' in English with correct Hindi and Marathi equivalents
The translation keys in ContactSection.tsx exactly match the keys defined in translations.ts (correct casing and nested dot paths)
No raw key string, escaped character, or JSON fragment is visible in the ContactSection in any language mode

file_operations.description: Update all t() translation helper calls to use exact camelCase nested dot-notation key names: 'contact.heading', 'contact.subheading', 'contact.info.heading', 'contact.form.heading', and 'contact.form.submit'. Verify each key path matches the translations.ts nested structure exactly. Ensure the component correctly receives and uses the t() function from LanguageContext.

Add or update all five contact translation keys (including nested keys under contact.info and contact.form) for all three language codes (en, hi, mr) with non-empty human-readable strings. English values: 'contact.heading' = 'Get In Touch', 'contact.subheading' = a concise invitation for international buyers to reach out, 'contact.info.heading' = 'Contact Information', 'contact.form.heading' = 'Send an Enquiry', 'contact.form.submit' = 'Submit'. Provide appropriate Hindi and Marathi translations for all five keys. Ensure the nested object structure (contact.info.*, contact.form.*) is correctly defined. Ensure no raw key strings, JSON objects, or template literal artifacts remain.
